CODTIPOPER, 'ENTRADA_POR_OS' AS PAPEL, 'NA' AS GRUPO_PRECO FROM DUAL ), jan AS ( SELECT TRUNC(SYSDATE) AS DT_BASE, TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') AS M0, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI') AS SNAPSHOT FROM DUAL ), voa AS ( SELECT V.CODPROD, V.CODVOL, MAX(V.DIVIDEMULTIPLICA) AS DM, MAX(V.QUANTIDADE) AS QC, COUNT(DISTINCT NVL(V.DIVIDEMULTIPLICA, '-') || '|' || NVL(CAST(V.QUANTIDADE AS VARCHAR(40)), '-')) AS N_REGRAS FROM TGFVOA V WHERE NVL(V.ATIVO, 'S') = 'S' GROUP BY V.CODPROD, V.CODVOL ), occ_it AS ( SELECT C.NUNOTA, I.SEQUENCIA, C.CODEMP, C.CODTIPOPER, C.DHTIPOPER, C.CODPARC, TP.GRUPO_PRECO, I.CODPROD, C.STATUSNOTA, TRUNC(C.DTNEG) AS DT_NEG, TRUNC(C.DTPREVENT) AS DT_PREV, NVL(I.PENDENTE, 'S') AS PENDENTE, NVL(I.CANCELADO, 'N') AS CANCELADO, NVL(I.QTDNEG, 0) AS QTDNEG, NVL(I.QTDENTREGUE, 0) AS QTDENT, NVL(I.VLRTOT, 0) AS VLRTOT, I.CODVOL AS UNID_ITEM, P.CODVOL AS UNID_PADRAO, CASE WHEN P.LEADTIME > 0 THEN P.LEADTIME END AS LT_CAD, NULLIF(TRIM(C.AD_OSTUICIAL), '') AS OS, (CASE WHEN I.CODVOL = P.CODVOL THEN 1 WHEN VO.N_REGRAS = 1 AND VO.DM = 'M' AND VO.QC > 0 THEN VO.QC WHEN VO.N_REGRAS = 1 AND VO.DM = 'D' AND VO.QC > 0 THEN 1 / VO.QC END) AS FATOR, (CASE WHEN I.CODVOL IS NULL THEN 'SEM_UNIDADE' WHEN I.CODVOL = P.CODVOL THEN 'PADRAO' WHEN VO.CODPROD IS NULL THEN 'SEM_REGRA' WHEN VO.N_REGRAS > 1 THEN 'AMBIGUA' WHEN VO.DM = 'M' AND VO.QC > 0 THEN 'MULTIPLICA' WHEN VO.DM = 'D' AND VO.QC > 0 THEN 'DIVIDE' ELSE 'REGRA_INVALIDA' END) AS STATUS_CONV, CASE WHEN C.DTNEG >= PR.DT_INI AND C.DTNEG < PR.DT_FIM + 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS FL_PERIODO, CASE WHEN (NVL(I.PENDENTE, 'S') = 'S' AND NVL(I.CANCELADO, 'N') <> 'S' AND NVL(I.QTDNEG, 0) > NVL(I.QTDENTREGUE, 0)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS FL_ABERTO FROM TGFCAB C JOIN tops TP ON TP.CODTIPOPER = C.CODTIPOPER JOIN TGFITE I ON I.NUNOTA = C.NUNOTA JOIN TGFPRO P ON P.CODPROD = I.CODPROD LEFT JOIN voa VO ON VO.CODPROD = I.CODPROD AND VO.CODVOL = I.CODVOL CROSS JOIN prm PR WHERE TP.PAPEL = 'ORDEM_COMPRA' AND (PR.CODEMP = 0 OR C.CODEMP = PR.CODEMP) AND ((C.DTNEG >= PR.DT_INI AND C.DTNEG < PR.DT_FIM + 1) OR (NVL(I.PENDENTE, 'S') = 'S' AND NVL(I.CANCELADO, 'N') <> 'S' AND NVL(I.QTDNEG, 0) > NVL(I.QTDENTREGUE, 0))) ), occ_lib AS ( SELECT L.NUCHAVE, SUM(CASE WHEN L.DHLIB IS NULL AND NVL(L.REPROVADO, 'N') <> 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS N_LIB_PEND, SUM(CASE WHEN NVL(L.REPROVADO, 'N') = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS N_LIB_REPROV FROM TSILIB L WHERE L.TABELA = 'TGFCAB' AND L.NUCHAVE IN (SELECT OI.NUNOTA FROM occ_it OI) GROUP BY L.NUCHAVE ), occ_var AS ( SELECT V.NUNOTAORIG, V.SEQUENCIAORIG, COUNT(DISTINCT V.NUNOTA) AS N_DERIV, MAX(TRUNC(N.DTNEG)) AS DT_ULT_DERIV FROM TGFVAR V JOIN TGFCAB N ON N.NUNOTA = V.NUNOTA WHERE N.STATUSNOTA = 'L' AND V.NUNOTA <> V.NUNOTAORIG AND V.NUNOTAORIG IN (SELECT OI.NUNOTA FROM occ_it OI) GROUP BY V.NUNOTAORIG, V.SEQUENCIAORIG ), occ_os_par AS ( SELECT O.NUNOTA, O.SEQUENCIA, E.NUNOTA AS NUNOTA_ENT, E.SEQUENCIA AS SEQ_ENT, TRUNC(N.DTNEG) AS DT_ENT FROM occ_it O JOIN TGFITE E ON E.CODPROD = O.CODPROD AND NULLIF(TRIM(E.AD_OS), '') = O.OS JOIN TGFCAB N ON N.NUNOTA = E.NUNOTA JOIN tops TE ON TE.CODTIPOPER = N.CODTIPOPER WHERE TE.PAPEL = 'ENTRADA_POR_OS' AND O.OS IS NOT NULL AND N.STATUSNOTA = 'L' AND N.DTNEG >= O.DT_NEG ), occ_os AS ( SELECT X.NUNOTA, X.SEQUENCIA, COUNT(*) AS N_ENT_OS, MAX(X.DT_ENT) AS DT_ULT_ENT_OS, MAX(X.N_OC_MESMA_ENT) AS MAX_OC_MESMA_ENT FROM (SELECT Y.NUNOTA, Y.SEQUENCIA, Y.DT_ENT, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY Y.NUNOTA_ENT, Y.SEQ_ENT) AS N_OC_MESMA_ENT FROM occ_os_par Y) X GROUP BY X.NUNOTA, X.SEQUENCIA ), occ AS ( SELECT O.NUNOTA, O.SEQUENCIA, O.CODEMP, O.CODTIPOPER, O.DHTIPOPER, O.CODPARC, O.GRUPO_PRECO, O.CODPROD, O.STATUSNOTA, O.DT_NEG, O.DT_PREV, O.PENDENTE, O.CANCELADO, O.QTDNEG, O.QTDENT, O.VLRTOT, O.UNID_ITEM, O.UNID_PADRAO, O.OS, O.FATOR, O.STATUS_CONV, O.FL_PERIODO, O.FL_ABERTO, CASE WHEN O.LT_CAD IS NOT NULL THEN TRUNC(O.DT_NEG + O.LT_CAD) END AS DT_PREV_ESTIMADA, NVL(LB.N_LIB_PEND, 0) AS N_LIB_PEND, NVL(LB.N_LIB_REPROV, 0) AS N_LIB_REPROV, (CASE WHEN O.STATUSNOTA = 'L' AND NVL(LB.N_LIB_PEND, 0) = 0 AND NVL(LB.N_LIB_REPROV, 0) = 0 THEN 'CONFIRMADA' WHEN O.STATUSNOTA = 'L' THEN 'APROVACAO_NAO_DETERMINADA' ELSE 'NAO_CONFIRMADA' END) AS SITUACAO, (CASE WHEN O.DT_PREV IS NULL THEN 'SEM_PREVISAO' WHEN O.DT_PREV < JA.DT_BASE THEN 'ATRASADA' ELSE 'NO_PRAZO' END) AS PRAZO, (CASE WHEN O.CANCELADO = 'S' THEN 'CANCELADA' WHEN O.QTDNEG > 0 AND O.QTDENT >= O.QTDNEG THEN 'ATENDIDA_INTEGRAL' WHEN O.PENDENTE = 'N' AND O.QTDENT > 0 THEN 'ENCERRADA_COM_SALDO' WHEN O.PENDENTE = 'N' THEN 'ENCERRADA_SEM_ATENDIMENTO' WHEN O.QTDENT > 0 THEN 'ATENDIMENTO_PARCIAL' ELSE 'ABERTA_SEM_ATENDIMENTO' END) AS STATUS_ITEM, CASE WHEN O.FL_ABERTO = 1 AND O.DT_PREV < JA.DT_BASE THEN JA.DT_BASE - O.DT_PREV END AS DIAS_ATRASO, JA.DT_BASE - O.DT_NEG AS IDADE_DIAS, CASE WHEN O.DT_NEG < ADD_MONTHS(JA.DT_BASE, -PR.OC_ANTIGA_MESES) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS FL_ANTIGA, CASE WHEN O.FL_ABERTO = 1 AND O.QTDNEG > 0 THEN O.VLRTOT * (O.QTDNEG - O.QTDENT) / O.QTDNEG ELSE 0 END AS VLR_SALDO, CASE WHEN O.FL_ABERTO = 1 AND O.FATOR IS NOT NULL THEN (O.QTDNEG - O.QTDENT) * O.FATOR END AS SALDO_BASE, CASE WHEN O.PENDENTE = 'N' AND O.CANCELADO <> 'S' AND O.QTDENT > 0 AND O.QTDENT < O.QTDNEG THEN O.QTDNEG - O.QTDENT ELSE 0 END AS SALDO_ENCERRADO_ORIG, CASE WHEN O.QTDENT > O.QTDNEG THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS FL_ACIMA_NEGOCIADO, NVL(VA.N_DERIV, 0) AS N_DERIV, VA.DT_ULT_DERIV, NVL(OSX.N_ENT_OS, 0) AS N_ENT_OS, OSX.DT_ULT_ENT_OS, NVL(OSX.MAX_OC_MESMA_ENT, 0) AS MAX_OC_MESMA_ENT, CASE WHEN NVL(VA.N_DERIV, 0) > 0 THEN 'NATIVO_TGFVAR' WHEN NVL(OSX.N_ENT_OS, 0) > 0 AND NVL(OSX.MAX_OC_MESMA_ENT, 0) > 1 THEN 'INFERIDO_OS_COMPARTILHADO' WHEN NVL(OSX.N_ENT_OS, 0) > 0 THEN 'INFERIDO_OS' WHEN O.QTDENT > 0 THEN 'ATENDIMENTO_SEM_VINCULO' ELSE 'SEM_ATENDIMENTO' END AS QUALIDADE_VINC FROM occ_it O LEFT JOIN occ_lib LB ON LB.NUCHAVE = O.NUNOTA LEFT JOIN occ_var VA ON VA.NUNOTAORIG = O.NUNOTA AND VA.SEQUENCIAORIG = O.SEQUENCIA LEFT JOIN occ_os OSX ON OSX.NUNOTA = O.NUNOTA AND OSX.SEQUENCIA = O.SEQUENCIA CROSS JOIN jan JA CROSS JOIN prm PR ), occ_fx AS ( SELECT O.NUNOTA, O.VLR_SALDO, CASE WHEN O.IDADE_DIAS <= 15 THEN '1_0_15' WHEN O.IDADE_DIAS <= 30 THEN '2_16_30' WHEN O.IDADE_DIAS <= 60 THEN '3_31_60' WHEN O.IDADE_DIAS <= 180 THEN '4_61_180' ELSE '5_181_MAIS' END AS FAIXA FROM occ O WHERE O.FL_ABERTO = 1 ), occ_pont AS ( SELECT O.NUNOTA, O.VLRTOT, CASE WHEN O.STATUS_ITEM = 'ATENDIDA_INTEGRAL' AND O.N_DERIV > 0 AND O.DT_ULT_DERIV <= O.DT_PREV + PR.TOLERANCIA_ATRASO_DIAS THEN 'INTEGRAL_NO_PRAZO' WHEN O.STATUS_ITEM = 'ATENDIDA_INTEGRAL' AND O.N_DERIV > 0 THEN 'INTEGRAL_FORA_PRAZO' WHEN O.STATUS_ITEM = 'ATENDIDA_INTEGRAL' THEN 'EXCLUIDO_SEM_DATA_CONFIAVEL' WHEN O.STATUS_ITEM IN ('ENCERRADA_COM_SALDO', 'ENCERRADA_SEM_ATENDIMENTO') THEN 'ENCERRADA_SEM_INTEGRAL' ELSE 'NAO_ATENDIDA_VENCIDA' END AS CLASSE FROM occ O CROSS JOIN prm PR CROSS JOIN jan JA WHERE O.SITUACAO = 'CONFIRMADA' AND O.CANCELADO <> 'S' AND O.QTDNEG > 0 AND O.DT_PREV >= PR.DT_INI AND O.DT_PREV < PR.DT_FIM + 1 AND O.DT_PREV < JA.DT_BASE ), occ_q AS ( SELECT 'OC_SEM_PREVISAO' AS CHAVE, O.NUNOTA FROM occ O WHERE O.FL_ABERTO = 1 AND O.PRAZO = 'SEM_PREVISAO' UNION ALL SELECT 'UNIDADE_NAO_CONCILIADA', O.NUNOTA FROM occ O WHERE O.FL_ABERTO = 1 AND O.FATOR IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'OC_ANTIGA_ABERTA', O.NUNOTA FROM occ O WHERE O.FL_ABERTO = 1 AND O.FL_ANTIGA = 1 UNION ALL SELECT 'NAO_CONFIRMADA', O.NUNOTA FROM occ O WHERE O.FL_ABERTO = 1 AND O.SITUACAO = 'NAO_CONFIRMADA' UNION ALL SELECT 'APROVACAO_NAO_DETERMINADA', O.NUNOTA FROM occ O WHERE O.FL_ABERTO = 1 AND O.SITUACAO = 'APROVACAO_NAO_DETERMINADA' UNION ALL SELECT 'ACIMA_NEGOCIADO', O.NUNOTA FROM occ O WHERE O.FL_ACIMA_NEGOCIADO = 1 UNION ALL SELECT 'ENCERRADA_COM_SALDO', O.NUNOTA FROM occ O WHERE O.FL_PERIODO = 1 AND O.STATUS_ITEM = 'ENCERRADA_COM_SALDO' UNION ALL SELECT 'ENTRADA_OS_COMPARTILHADA', O.NUNOTA FROM occ O WHERE O.MAX_OC_MESMA_ENT > 1 UNION ALL SELECT 'TOP_PRECO_SEPARADO_ABERTA', O.NUNOTA FROM occ O WHERE O.FL_ABERTO = 1 AND O.GRUPO_PRECO = 'SEPARADO' ), blocos AS ( SELECT 'ABERTO' AS BLOCO, O.SITUACAO AS CHAVE, O.PRAZO AS CHAVE2, COUNT(DISTINCT O.NUNOTA) AS N_OCS, COUNT(*) AS N_ITENS, SUM(O.VLR_SALDO) AS VLR, SUM(CASE WHEN O.FATOR IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS N_AUX FROM occ O WHERE O.FL_ABERTO = 1 GROUP BY O.SITUACAO, O.PRAZO UNION ALL SELECT 'FUNIL', O.STATUS_ITEM, O.SITUACAO, COUNT(DISTINCT O.NUNOTA), COUNT(*), SUM(O.VLRTOT), 0 FROM occ O WHERE O.FL_PERIODO = 1 GROUP BY O.STATUS_ITEM, O.SITUACAO UNION ALL SELECT 'AGING', F.FAIXA, '-', COUNT(DISTINCT F.NUNOTA), COUNT(*), SUM(F.VLR_SALDO), 0 FROM occ_fx F GROUP BY F.FAIXA UNION ALL SELECT 'PONTUALIDADE', P.CLASSE, '-', COUNT(DISTINCT P.NUNOTA), COUNT(*), SUM(P.VLRTOT), 0 FROM occ_pont P GROUP BY P.CLASSE UNION ALL SELECT 'VINCULO', O.QUALIDADE_VINC, '-', COUNT(DISTINCT O.NUNOTA), COUNT(*), SUM(O.VLRTOT), 0 FROM occ O WHERE O.FL_PERIODO = 1 AND O.QTDENT > 0 GROUP BY O.QUALIDADE_VINC UNION ALL SELECT 'QUALIDADE', Q.CHAVE, '-', COUNT(DISTINCT Q.NUNOTA), COUNT(*), 0, 0 FROM occ_q Q GROUP BY Q.CHAVE ) SELECT B.BLOCO, B.CHAVE, B.CHAVE2, B.N_OCS, B.N_ITENS, ROUND(B.VLR, 2) AS VLR, B.N_AUX, TO_CHAR(JA.DT_BASE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS DT_BASE, JA.SNAPSHOT FROM blocos B CROSS JOIN jan JA ORDER BY B.BLOCO, B.CHAVE, B.CHAVE2

VO.CODPROD = I.CODPROD AND VO.CODVOL = I.CODVOL CROSS JOIN prm PR CROSS JOIN janc JC WHERE TP.PAPEL IN ('CONSUMO', 'DEVOLUCAO', 'PERDA') AND C.STATUSNOTA = 'L' AND NVL(I.CANCELADO, 'N') <> 'S' AND C.DTNEG >= JC.HORIZ_INI AND C.DTNEG < JC.DT_BASE AND (PR.CODEMP = 0 OR C.CODEMP = PR.CODEMP) ), cons_mes AS ( SELECT M.CODEMP, M.CODPROD, M.IDX_MES, SUM(CASE WHEN M.FATOR IS NULL THEN 0 WHEN M.PAPEL = 'DEVOLUCAO' THEN -M.QTD_ORIG * M.FATOR ELSE M.QTD_ORIG * M.FATOR END) AS QTD, SUM(CASE WHEN M.FATOR IS NOT NULL AND M.PAPEL = 'CONSUMO' THEN M.QTD_ORIG * M.FATOR ELSE 0 END) AS QTD_SAIDA, SUM(CASE WHEN M.FATOR IS NOT NULL AND M.PAPEL = 'DEVOLUCAO' THEN M.QTD_ORIG * M.FATOR ELSE 0 END) AS QTD_DEVOL, SUM(CASE WHEN M.FATOR IS NOT NULL AND M.PAPEL = 'PERDA' THEN M.QTD_ORIG * M.FATOR ELSE 0 END) AS QTD_PERDA, SUM(CASE WHEN M.PAPEL = 'CONSUMO' THEN M.VLR WHEN M.PAPEL = 'DEVOLUCAO' THEN -M.VLR ELSE 0 END) AS VLR_FAT, SUM(CASE WHEN M.FATOR IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS N_NAO_CONC FROM cmov M GROUP BY M.CODEMP, M.CODPROD, M.IDX_MES ), serie AS ( SELECT M.CODEMP, M.CODPROD, MIN(M.IDX_MES) AS IDX_PRIM, MIN(M.DT) AS DT_PRIM FROM cmov M WHERE M.PAPEL = 'CONSUMO' GROUP BY M.CODEMP, M.CODPROD ), med0 AS ( SELECT S.CODEMP, S.CODPROD, S.IDX_PRIM, S.DT_PRIM, CASE WHEN S.IDX_PRIM < JC.IDX_M0 - JC.N THEN 'ANTIGO' WHEN S.IDX_PRIM < JC.IDX_M0 THEN 'NOVO' ELSE 'SO_MES_ATUAL' END AS ORIGEM_SERIE, CASE WHEN S.IDX_PRIM < JC.IDX_M0 - JC.N THEN JC.N WHEN S.IDX_PRIM < JC.IDX_M0 THEN JC.IDX_M0 - S.IDX_PRIM ELSE 0 END AS N_MESES FROM serie S CROSS JOIN janc JC ), cons_ag AS ( SELECT CM.CODEMP, CM.CODPROD, SUM(CASE WHEN JC.IDX_M0 - CM.IDX_MES BETWEEN 1 AND NVL(M0.N_MESES, 0) THEN CM.QTD ELSE 0 END) AS QTD_JANELA, SUM(CASE WHEN CM.IDX_MES = JC.IDX_M0 THEN CM.QTD ELSE 0 END) AS QTD_PARCIAL, SUM(CASE WHEN JC.IDX_M0 - CM.IDX_MES BETWEEN 1 AND LEAST(NVL(M0.N_MESES, 0), 3) THEN CM.QTD ELSE 0 END) AS QTD_3M, SUM(CASE WHEN JC.IDX_M0 - CM.IDX_MES BETWEEN 1 AND NVL(M0.N_MESES, 0) THEN CM.QTD * ((CASE WHEN JC.IDX_M0 - CM.IDX_MES <= 3 THEN 0.5 / 3 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN JC.IDX_M0 - CM.IDX_MES <= 6 THEN 0.3 / 6 ELSE 0 END) + 0.2 / JC.N) ELSE 0 END) AS POND_NUM, SUM(CASE WHEN JC.IDX_M0 - CM.IDX_MES BETWEEN 1 AND JC.N THEN CM.N_NAO_CONC WHEN CM.IDX_MES = JC.IDX_M0 AND PR.MES_PARCIAL = 1 THEN CM.N_NAO_CONC ELSE 0 END) AS N_CONS_NAO_CONC, SUM(CASE WHEN JC.IDX_M0 - CM.IDX_MES BETWEEN 1 AND JC.N THEN CM.VLR_FAT ELSE 0 END) AS VLR_FAT_JANELA FROM cons_mes CM LEFT JOIN med0 M0 ON M0.CODEMP = CM.CODEMP AND M0.CODPROD = CM.CODPROD CROSS JOIN janc JC CROSS JOIN prm PR GROUP BY CM.CODEMP, CM.CODPROD ), med AS ( SELECT K.CODEMP, K.CODPROD, NVL(M0.ORIGEM_SERIE, 'SEM_CONSUMO') AS ORIGEM_SERIE, M0.DT_PRIM AS DT_PRIM_CONSUMO, NVL(M0.N_MESES, 0) AS N_MESES, CASE WHEN PR.MES_PARCIAL = 1 AND M0.CODPROD IS NOT NULL THEN JC.FRAC ELSE 0 END AS FRAC_USADA, NVL(CA.QTD_JANELA, 0) AS QTD_JANELA, NVL(CA.QTD_PARCIAL, 0) AS QTD_PARCIAL, NVL(CA.QTD_3M, 0) AS QTD_3M, NVL(CA.POND_NUM, 0) AS POND_NUM, NVL(CA.N_CONS_NAO_CONC, 0) AS N_CONS_NAO_CONC, NVL(CA.VLR_FAT_JANELA, 0) AS VLR_FAT_JANELA FROM (SELECT CA0.CODEMP, CA0.CODPROD FROM cons_ag CA0 UNION SELECT MZ.CODEMP, MZ.CODPROD FROM med0 MZ) K LEFT JOIN med0 M0 ON M0.CODEMP = K.CODEMP AND M0.CODPROD = K.CODPROD LEFT JOIN cons_ag CA ON CA.CODEMP = K.CODEMP AND CA.CODPROD = K.CODPROD CROSS JOIN prm PR CROSS JOIN janc JC ), med2 AS ( SELECT MD.CODEMP, MD.CODPROD, MD.ORIGEM_SERIE, MD.DT_PRIM_CONSUMO, MD.N_MESES, MD.FRAC_USADA, MD.QTD_JANELA, MD.QTD_PARCIAL, MD.QTD_3M, MD.N_CONS_NAO_CONC, MD.VLR_FAT_JANELA, CASE WHEN MD.N_MESES + MD.FRAC_USADA > 0 THEN (MD.QTD_JANELA + CASE WHEN MD.FRAC_USADA > 0 THEN MD.QTD_PARCIAL ELSE 0 END) / (MD.N_MESES + MD.FRAC_USADA) END AS MEDIA_SIMPLES, CASE WHEN MD.N_MESES >= 1 THEN MD.POND_NUM / (0.5 / 3 * LEAST(MD.N_MESES, 3) + 0.3 / 6 * LEAST(MD.N_MESES, 6) + 0.2 / JC.N * MD.N_MESES) END AS MEDIA_PONDERADA, CASE WHEN MD.N_MESES >= 1 THEN MD.QTD_3M / LEAST(MD.N_MESES, 3) END AS MEDIA_3M FROM med MD CROSS JOIN janc JC ), med3 AS ( SELECT M2.CODEMP, M2.CODPROD, M2.ORIGEM_SERIE, M2.DT_PRIM_CONSUMO, M2.N_MESES, M2.FRAC_USADA, M2.QTD_JANELA, M2.QTD_PARCIAL, M2.QTD_3M, M2.N_CONS_NAO_CONC, M2.VLR_FAT_JANELA, M2.MEDIA_SIMPLES, M2.MEDIA_PONDERADA, M2.MEDIA_3M, CASE WHEN PR.MEDIA_MODO = 1 THEN M2.MEDIA_PONDERADA ELSE M2.MEDIA_SIMPLES END AS MEDIA_CALC, CASE WHEN M2.ORIGEM_SERIE IN ('NOVO', 'SO_MES_ATUAL') AND M2.N_MESES + M2.FRAC_USADA < PR.MIN_MESES_HIST THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS FL_HIST_INSUF FROM med2 M2 CROSS JOIN prm PR ), prod AS ( SELECT P.CODPROD, P.DESCRPROD, P.CODVOL AS UNIDADE, P.CODGRUPOPROD AS GRUPO, G.DESCRGRUPOPROD AS GRUPO_DESCR, CASE WHEN P.LEADTIME > 0 THEN P.LEADTIME END AS LT_CAD, CASE WHEN P.ESTMIN > 0 THEN P.ESTMIN END AS ESTMIN_CAD, P.AGRUPMIN AS AGRUPMIN, P.LOTECOMPMINIMO AS LOTEMIN, CASE WHEN NVL(P.CODPARCCONSIG, 0) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS FL_CONSIGNADO, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR(60)) AS COD_ANTIGO FROM TGFPRO P LEFT JOIN TGFGRU G ON G.CODGRUPOPROD = P.CODGRUPOPROD WHERE P.ATIVO = 'S' ), sel AS ( SELECT M.CODEMP, M.CODPROD, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY M.VLR_FAT_JANELA DESC, M.CODEMP, M.CODPROD) AS RK FROM med3 M JOIN prod PD ON PD.CODPROD = M.CODPROD CROSS JOIN prm PR WHERE PR.CODPROD_FILTRO = 0 OR M.CODPROD = PR.CODPROD_FILTRO ) SELECT S.RK, M.CODEMP, M.CODPROD, PD.DESCRPROD, PD.UNIDADE, M.ORIGEM_SERIE, TO_CHAR(M.DT_PRIM_CONSUMO, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS DT_PRIM_CONSUMO, M.N_MESES, ROUND(M.FRAC_USADA, 4) AS FRAC_USADA, ROUND(M.QTD_JANELA, 3) AS QTD_JANELA, ROUND(M.QTD_PARCIAL, 3) AS QTD_PARCIAL, ROUND(M.MEDIA_SIMPLES, 3) AS MEDIA_SIMPLES, ROUND(M.MEDIA_PONDERADA, 3) AS MEDIA_PONDERADA, ROUND(GREATEST(NVL(M.MEDIA_CALC, 0), 0), 3) AS MEDIA_USADA, ROUND(M.MEDIA_3M, 3) AS MEDIA_3M, CASE WHEN M.MEDIA_CALC > 0 AND M.MEDIA_3M IS NOT NULL THEN ROUND(M.MEDIA_3M / M.MEDIA_CALC - 1, 4) END AS DESVIO, M.FL_HIST_INSUF, M.N_CONS_NAO_CONC, ROUND(M.VLR_FAT_JANELA, 2) AS VLR_FAT_JANELA, CM.IDX_MES, ROUND(CM.QTD, 3) AS QTD, ROUND(CM.QTD_SAIDA, 3) AS QTD_SAIDA, ROUND(CM.QTD_DEVOL, 3) AS QTD_DEVOL, ROUND(CM.QTD_PERDA, 3) AS QTD_PERDA, CM.N_NAO_CONC, JC.IDX_M0, JC.N AS MESES_JANELA, TO_CHAR(JC.INI, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS JANELA_INI, TO_CHAR(JC.DT_BASE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS DT_BASE FROM sel S JOIN med3 M ON M.CODEMP = S.CODEMP AND M.CODPROD = S.CODPROD JOIN prod PD ON PD.CODPROD = S.CODPROD CROSS JOIN janc JC CROSS JOIN prm PR LEFT JOIN cons_mes CM ON CM.CODEMP = S.CODEMP AND CM.CODPROD = S.CODPROD AND CM.IDX_MES >= JC.IDX_M0 - JC.N AND CM.IDX_MES <= JC.IDX_M0 WHERE S.RK <= PR.TOPN_CONSUMO ORDER BY S.RK, CM.IDX_MES NULLS FIRST

CODTIPOPER, 'ENTRADA_POR_OS' AS PAPEL, 'NA' AS GRUPO_PRECO FROM DUAL ), jan AS ( SELECT TRUNC(SYSDATE) AS DT_BASE, TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') AS M0, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI') AS SNAPSHOT FROM DUAL ), voa AS ( SELECT V.CODPROD, V.CODVOL, MAX(V.DIVIDEMULTIPLICA) AS DM, MAX(V.QUANTIDADE) AS QC, COUNT(DISTINCT NVL(V.DIVIDEMULTIPLICA, '-') || '|' || NVL(CAST(V.QUANTIDADE AS VARCHAR(40)), '-')) AS N_REGRAS FROM TGFVOA V WHERE NVL(V.ATIVO, 'S') = 'S' GROUP BY V.CODPROD, V.CODVOL ), occ_it AS ( SELECT C.NUNOTA, I.SEQUENCIA, C.CODEMP, C.CODTIPOPER, C.DHTIPOPER, C.CODPARC, TP.GRUPO_PRECO, I.CODPROD, C.STATUSNOTA, TRUNC(C.DTNEG) AS DT_NEG, TRUNC(C.DTPREVENT) AS DT_PREV, NVL(I.PENDENTE, 'S') AS PENDENTE, NVL(I.CANCELADO, 'N') AS CANCELADO, NVL(I.QTDNEG, 0) AS QTDNEG, NVL(I.QTDENTREGUE, 0) AS QTDENT, NVL(I.VLRTOT, 0) AS VLRTOT, I.CODVOL AS UNID_ITEM, P.CODVOL AS UNID_PADRAO, CASE WHEN P.LEADTIME > 0 THEN P.LEADTIME END AS LT_CAD, NULLIF(TRIM(C.AD_OSTUICIAL), '') AS OS, (CASE WHEN I.CODVOL = P.CODVOL THEN 1 WHEN VO.N_REGRAS = 1 AND VO.DM = 'M' AND VO.QC > 0 THEN VO.QC WHEN VO.N_REGRAS = 1 AND VO.DM = 'D' AND VO.QC > 0 THEN 1 / VO.QC END) AS FATOR, (CASE WHEN I.CODVOL IS NULL THEN 'SEM_UNIDADE' WHEN I.CODVOL = P.CODVOL THEN 'PADRAO' WHEN VO.CODPROD IS NULL THEN 'SEM_REGRA' WHEN VO.N_REGRAS > 1 THEN 'AMBIGUA' WHEN VO.DM = 'M' AND VO.QC > 0 THEN 'MULTIPLICA' WHEN VO.DM = 'D' AND VO.QC > 0 THEN 'DIVIDE' ELSE 'REGRA_INVALIDA' END) AS STATUS_CONV, CASE WHEN C.DTNEG >= PR.DT_INI AND C.DTNEG < PR.DT_FIM + 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS FL_PERIODO, CASE WHEN (NVL(I.PENDENTE, 'S') = 'S' AND NVL(I.CANCELADO, 'N') <> 'S' AND NVL(I.QTDNEG, 0) > NVL(I.QTDENTREGUE, 0)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS FL_ABERTO FROM TGFCAB C JOIN tops TP ON TP.CODTIPOPER = C.CODTIPOPER JOIN TGFITE I ON I.NUNOTA = C.NUNOTA JOIN TGFPRO P ON P.CODPROD = I.CODPROD LEFT JOIN voa VO ON VO.CODPROD = I.CODPROD AND VO.CODVOL = I.CODVOL CROSS JOIN prm PR WHERE TP.PAPEL = 'ORDEM_COMPRA' AND (PR.CODEMP = 0 OR C.CODEMP = PR.CODEMP) AND ((C.DTNEG >= PR.DT_INI AND C.DTNEG < PR.DT_FIM + 1) OR (NVL(I.PENDENTE, 'S') = 'S' AND NVL(I.CANCELADO, 'N') <> 'S' AND NVL(I.QTDNEG, 0) > NVL(I.QTDENTREGUE, 0))) ), occ_lib AS ( SELECT L.NUCHAVE, SUM(CASE WHEN L.DHLIB IS NULL AND NVL(L.REPROVADO, 'N') <> 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS N_LIB_PEND, SUM(CASE WHEN NVL(L.REPROVADO, 'N') = 'S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS N_LIB_REPROV FROM TSILIB L WHERE L.TABELA = 'TGFCAB' AND L.NUCHAVE IN (SELECT OI.NUNOTA FROM occ_it OI) GROUP BY L.NUCHAVE ), occ_var AS ( SELECT V.NUNOTAORIG, V.SEQUENCIAORIG, COUNT(DISTINCT V.NUNOTA) AS N_DERIV, MAX(TRUNC(N.DTNEG)) AS DT_ULT_DERIV FROM TGFVAR V JOIN TGFCAB N ON N.NUNOTA = V.NUNOTA WHERE N.STATUSNOTA = 'L' AND V.NUNOTA <> V.NUNOTAORIG AND V.NUNOTAORIG IN (SELECT OI.NUNOTA FROM occ_it OI) GROUP BY V.NUNOTAORIG, V.SEQUENCIAORIG ), occ_os_par AS ( SELECT O.NUNOTA, O.SEQUENCIA, E.NUNOTA AS NUNOTA_ENT, E.SEQUENCIA AS SEQ_ENT, TRUNC(N.DTNEG) AS DT_ENT FROM occ_it O JOIN TGFITE E ON E.CODPROD = O.CODPROD AND NULLIF(TRIM(E.AD_OS), '') = O.OS JOIN TGFCAB N ON N.NUNOTA = E.NUNOTA JOIN tops TE ON TE.CODTIPOPER = N.CODTIPOPER WHERE TE.PAPEL = 'ENTRADA_POR_OS' AND O.OS IS NOT NULL AND N.STATUSNOTA = 'L' AND N.DTNEG >= O.DT_NEG ), occ_os AS ( SELECT X.NUNOTA, X.SEQUENCIA, COUNT(*) AS N_ENT_OS, MAX(X.DT_ENT) AS DT_ULT_ENT_OS, MAX(X.N_OC_MESMA_ENT) AS MAX_OC_MESMA_ENT FROM (SELECT Y.NUNOTA, Y.SEQUENCIA, Y.DT_ENT, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY Y.NUNOTA_ENT, Y.SEQ_ENT) AS N_OC_MESMA_ENT FROM occ_os_par Y) X GROUP BY X.NUNOTA, X.SEQUENCIA ), occ AS ( SELECT O.NUNOTA, O.SEQUENCIA, O.CODEMP, O.CODTIPOPER, O.DHTIPOPER, O.CODPARC, O.GRUPO_PRECO, O.CODPROD, O.STATUSNOTA, O.DT_NEG, O.DT_PREV, O.PENDENTE, O.CANCELADO, O.QTDNEG, O.QTDENT, O.VLRTOT, O.UNID_ITEM, O.UNID_PADRAO, O.OS, O.FATOR, O.STATUS_CONV, O.FL_PERIODO, O.FL_ABERTO, CASE WHEN O.LT_CAD IS NOT NULL THEN TRUNC(O.DT_NEG + O.LT_CAD) END AS DT_PREV_ESTIMADA, NVL(LB.N_LIB_PEND, 0) AS N_LIB_PEND, NVL(LB.N_LIB_REPROV, 0) AS N_LIB_REPROV, (CASE WHEN O.STATUSNOTA = 'L' AND NVL(LB.N_LIB_PEND, 0) = 0 AND NVL(LB.N_LIB_REPROV, 0) = 0 THEN 'CONFIRMADA' WHEN O.STATUSNOTA = 'L' THEN 'APROVACAO_NAO_DETERMINADA' ELSE 'NAO_CONFIRMADA' END) AS SITUACAO, (CASE WHEN O.DT_PREV IS NULL THEN 'SEM_PREVISAO' WHEN O.DT_PREV < JA.DT_BASE THEN 'ATRASADA' ELSE 'NO_PRAZO' END) AS PRAZO, (CASE WHEN O.CANCELADO = 'S' THEN 'CANCELADA' WHEN O.QTDNEG > 0 AND O.QTDENT >= O.QTDNEG THEN 'ATENDIDA_INTEGRAL' WHEN O.PENDENTE = 'N' AND O.QTDENT > 0 THEN 'ENCERRADA_COM_SALDO' WHEN O.PENDENTE = 'N' THEN 'ENCERRADA_SEM_ATENDIMENTO' WHEN O.QTDENT > 0 THEN 'ATENDIMENTO_PARCIAL' ELSE 'ABERTA_SEM_ATENDIMENTO' END) AS STATUS_ITEM, CASE WHEN O.FL_ABERTO = 1 AND O.DT_PREV < JA.DT_BASE THEN JA.DT_BASE - O.DT_PREV END AS DIAS_ATRASO, JA.DT_BASE - O.DT_NEG AS IDADE_DIAS, CASE WHEN O.DT_NEG < ADD_MONTHS(JA.DT_BASE, -PR.OC_ANTIGA_MESES) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS FL_ANTIGA, CASE WHEN O.FL_ABERTO = 1 AND O.QTDNEG > 0 THEN O.VLRTOT * (O.QTDNEG - O.QTDENT) / O.QTDNEG ELSE 0 END AS VLR_SALDO, CASE WHEN O.FL_ABERTO = 1 AND O.FATOR IS NOT NULL THEN (O.QTDNEG - O.QTDENT) * O.FATOR END AS SALDO_BASE, CASE WHEN O.PENDENTE = 'N' AND O.CANCELADO <> 'S' AND O.QTDENT > 0 AND O.QTDENT < O.QTDNEG THEN O.QTDNEG - O.QTDENT ELSE 0 END AS SALDO_ENCERRADO_ORIG, CASE WHEN O.QTDENT > O.QTDNEG THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS FL_ACIMA_NEGOCIADO, NVL(VA.N_DERIV, 0) AS N_DERIV, VA.DT_ULT_DERIV, NVL(OSX.N_ENT_OS, 0) AS N_ENT_OS, OSX.DT_ULT_ENT_OS, NVL(OSX.MAX_OC_MESMA_ENT, 0) AS MAX_OC_MESMA_ENT, CASE WHEN NVL(VA.N_DERIV, 0) > 0 THEN 'NATIVO_TGFVAR' WHEN NVL(OSX.N_ENT_OS, 0) > 0 AND NVL(OSX.MAX_OC_MESMA_ENT, 0) > 1 THEN 'INFERIDO_OS_COMPARTILHADO' WHEN NVL(OSX.N_ENT_OS, 0) > 0 THEN 'INFERIDO_OS' WHEN O.QTDENT > 0 THEN 'ATENDIMENTO_SEM_VINCULO' ELSE 'SEM_ATENDIMENTO' END AS QUALIDADE_VINC FROM occ_it O LEFT JOIN occ_lib LB ON LB.NUCHAVE = O.NUNOTA LEFT JOIN occ_var VA ON VA.NUNOTAORIG = O.NUNOTA AND VA.SEQUENCIAORIG = O.SEQUENCIA LEFT JOIN occ_os OSX ON OSX.NUNOTA = O.NUNOTA AND OSX.SEQUENCIA = O.SEQUENCIA CROSS JOIN jan JA CROSS JOIN prm PR ), lista AS ( SELECT O.*, PA.NOMEPARC AS FORNECEDOR, T.DESCROPER AS DESCR_TOP, PD.DESCRPROD FROM occ O JOIN TGFPRO PD ON PD.CODPROD = O.CODPROD LEFT JOIN TGFPAR PA ON PA.CODPARC = O.CODPARC LEFT JOIN TGFTOP T ON T.CODTIPOPER = O.CODTIPOPER AND T.DHALTER = O.DHTIPOPER CROSS JOIN prm PR WHERE O.FL_ABERTO = 1 AND (PR.CODPROD_FILTRO = 0 OR O.CODPROD = PR.CODPROD_FILTRO) AND (PR.FILTRO_OC = 'TODAS' OR (PR.FILTRO_OC = 'ATRASADAS' AND O.PRAZO = 'ATRASADA') OR I.CODVOL = P.CODVOL THEN 1 WHEN VO.N_REGRAS = 1 AND VO.DM = 'M' AND VO.QC > 0 THEN VO.QC WHEN VO.N_REGRAS = 1 AND VO.DM = 'D' AND VO.QC > 0 THEN 1 / VO.QC END) AS FATOR FROM TGFCAB C JOIN tops TP ON TP.CODTIPOPER = C.CODTIPOPER JOIN TGFITE I ON I.NUNOTA = C.NUNOTA JOIN TGFPRO P ON P.CODPROD = I.CODPROD LEFT JOIN voa VO ON VO.CODPROD = I.CODPROD AND VO.CODVOL = I.CODVOL CROSS JOIN prm PR WHERE TP.PAPEL = 'COTACAO' AND (NVL(I.PENDENTE, 'S') = 'S' AND NVL(I.CANCELADO, 'N') <> 'S' AND NVL(I.QTDNEG, 0) > NVL(I.QTDENTREGUE, 0)) AND (PR.CODEMP = 0 OR C.CODEMP = PR.CODEMP) ), cot AS ( SELECT X.CODEMP, X.CODPROD, SUM(CASE WHEN X.FATOR IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE X.SALDO_ORIG * X.FATOR END) AS QTD_COTACAO, SUM(CASE WHEN X.FATOR IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS N_COT_NAO_CONC FROM cot_it X GROUP BY X.CODEMP, X.CODPROD ), preco_it AS ( SELECT I.CODPROD, TP.GRUPO_PRECO, C.NUNOTA, C.CODTIPOPER, TRUNC(C.DTNEG) AS DT_NEG, NVL(I.VLRTOT, 0) / (NVL(I.QTDNEG, 0) * (CASE WHEN I.CODVOL = P.CODVOL THEN 1 WHEN VO.N_REGRAS = 1 AND VO.DM = 'M' AND VO.QC > 0 THEN VO.QC WHEN VO.N_REGRAS = 1 AND VO.DM = 'D' AND VO.QC > 0 THEN 1 / VO.QC END)) AS PRECO_BASE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY I.CODPROD, TP.GRUPO_PRECO ORDER BY C.DTNEG DESC, C.NUNOTA DESC, I.SEQUENCIA DESC) AS RN FROM TGFCAB C JOIN tops TP ON TP.CODTIPOPER = C.CODTIPOPER JOIN TGFITE I ON I.NUNOTA = C.NUNOTA JOIN TGFPRO P ON P.CODPROD = I.CODPROD LEFT JOIN voa VO ON VO.CODPROD = I.CODPROD AND VO.CODVOL = I.CODVOL CROSS JOIN prm PR CROSS JOIN janc JC WHERE TP.PAPEL = 'ORDEM_COMPRA' AND C.STATUSNOTA = 'L' AND NVL(I.CANCELADO, 'N') <> 'S' AND NVL(I.QTDNEG, 0) > 0 AND NVL(I.VLRTOT, 0) > 0 AND (CASE WHEN I.CODVOL = P.CODVOL THEN 1 WHEN VO.N_REGRAS = 1 AND VO.DM = 'M' AND VO.QC > 0 THEN VO.QC WHEN VO.N_REGRAS = 1 AND VO.DM = 'D' AND VO.QC > 0 THEN 1 / VO.QC END) IS NOT NULL AND C.DTNEG >= JC.HORIZ_INI AND C.DTNEG < JC.DT_BASE + 1 AND (PR.CODEMP = 0 OR C.CODEMP = PR.CODEMP) ), preco AS ( SELECT X.CODPROD, MAX(CASE WHEN X.GRUPO_PRECO = 'PRINCIPAL' THEN X.PRECO_BASE END) AS PRECO_REF, MAX(CASE WHEN X.GRUPO_PRECO = 'PRINCIPAL' THEN X.DT_NEG END) AS PRECO_REF_DATA, MAX(CASE WHEN X.GRUPO_PRECO = 'PRINCIPAL' THEN X.NUNOTA END) AS PRECO_REF_NUNOTA, MAX(CASE WHEN X.GRUPO_PRECO = 'PRINCIPAL' THEN X.CODTIPOPER END) AS PRECO_REF_TOP, MAX(CASE WHEN X.GRUPO_PRECO = 'SEPARADO' THEN X.PRECO_BASE END) AS PRECO_SEP, MAX(CASE WHEN X.GRUPO_PRECO = 'SEPARADO' THEN X.DT_NEG END) AS PRECO_SEP_DATA FROM preco_it X WHERE X.RN = 1 GROUP BY X.CODPROD ), chaves AS ( SELECT ES.CODEMP, ES.CODPROD FROM est ES WHERE ES.QTD_ESTOQUE <> 0 OR ES.QTD_RESERVADO <> 0 OR ES.QTD_BLOQUEADO <> 0 UNION SELECT MD.CODEMP, MD.CODPROD FROM med3 MD UNION SELECT CP.CODEMP, CP.CODPROD FROM cmp CP UNION SELECT OP.CODEMP, OP.CODPROD FROM oc_pos OP UNION SELECT CT.CODEMP, CT.CODPROD FROM cot CT ), b1 AS ( SELECT K.CODEMP, K.CODPROD, PD.DESCRPROD, PD.UNIDADE, PD.GRUPO, PD.GRUPO_DESCR, PD.ESTMIN_CAD, PD.AGRUPMIN, PD.LOTEMIN, PD.FL_CONSIGNADO, PD.COD_ANTIGO, JA.DT_BASE, NVL(ES.QTD_ESTOQUE, 0) AS QTD_ESTOQUE, NVL(ES.QTD_RESERVADO, 0) AS QTD_RESERVADO, NVL(ES.QTD_BLOQUEADO, 0) AS QTD_BLOQUEADO, NVL(CP.QTD_PEDIDOS, 0) AS QTD_PEDIDOS, NVL(CP.QTD_CONFERIDA, 0) AS QTD_CONFERIDA, NVL(CP.N_PED_NAO_CONC, 0) AS N_PED_NAO_CONC, NVL(MD.ORIGEM_SERIE, 'SEM_CONSUMO') AS ORIGEM_SERIE, MD.DT_PRIM_CONSUMO, NVL(MD.N_MESES, 0) AS N_MESES, NVL(MD.FRAC_USADA, 0) AS FRAC_USADA, NVL(MD.QTD_JANELA, 0) AS QTD_JANELA, NVL(MD.QTD_PARCIAL, 0) AS QTD_PARCIAL, MD.MEDIA_SIMPLES, MD.MEDIA_PONDERADA, MD.MEDIA_3M, MD.MEDIA_CALC, NVL(MD.FL_HIST_INSUF, 0) AS FL_HIST_INSUF, NVL(MD.N_CONS_NAO_CONC, 0) AS N_CONS_NAO_CONC, CASE WHEN MD.MEDIA_CALC < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS FL_CONSUMO_NEG, NVL(OP.QTD_OC_CONF, 0) AS QTD_OC_CONF, NVL(OP.QTD_OC_CONF_PRAZO, 0) AS QTD_OC_CONF_PRAZO, NVL(OP.QTD_OC_CONF_ATRAS, 0) AS QTD_OC_CONF_ATRAS, NVL(OP.QTD_OC_CONF_SEMPREV, 0) AS QTD_OC_CONF_SEMPREV, NVL(OP.QTD_OC_NAO_CONF, 0) AS QTD_OC_NAO_CONF, NVL(OP.N_OCS_ABERTAS, 0) AS N_OCS_ABERTAS, NVL(OP.N_OC_NAO_CONC, 0) AS N_OC_NAO_CONC, NVL(OP.N_OC_SEM_PREV, 0) AS N_OC_SEM_PREV, NVL(OP.N_OC_ATRAS, 0) AS N_OC_ATRAS, NVL(OP.N_OC_ANTIGA, 0) AS N_OC_ANTIGA, NVL(OP.N_OC_TOP_SEP, 0) AS N_OC_TOP_SEP, CASE WHEN 0 = 1 THEN NVL(CT.QTD_COTACAO, 0) END AS QTD_COTACAO, NVL(CT.N_COT_NAO_CONC, 0) AS N_COT_NAO_CONC, PZ.PRECO_REF, PZ.PRECO_REF_DATA, PZ.PRECO_REF_NUNOTA, PZ.PRECO_REF_TOP, PZ.PRECO_SEP, PZ.PRECO_SEP_DATA, CASE WHEN PD.LT_CAD > 0 THEN PD.LT_CAD ELSE PR.LEADTIME_DEFAULT END AS LT, CASE WHEN PD.LT_CAD > 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS FL_LT_PADRAO, NVL(ES.QTD_ESTOQUE, 0) - CASE WHEN PR.DESCONTA_BLOQUEADO = 1 THEN NVL(ES.QTD_BLOQUEADO, 0) ELSE 0 END AS EFP, CASE WHEN PR.FONTE_COMPROMISSO = 2 THEN NVL(ES.QTD_RESERVADO, 0) ELSE NVL(CP.QTD_PEDIDOS, 0) END AS CMP, GREATEST(NVL(MD.MEDIA_CALC, 0), 0) AS MEDIA_USADA, GREATEST(NVL(MD.MEDIA_CALC, 0), 0) / PR.DIAS_MES AS DD, CASE WHEN GREATEST(NVL(MD.MEDIA_CALC, 0), 0) = 0 AND NVL(MD.ORIGEM_SERIE, 'SEM_CONSUMO') <> 'SO_MES_ATUAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS FL_SEM_GIRO FROM chaves K JOIN prod PD ON PD.CODPROD = K.CODPROD LEFT JOIN est ES ON ES.CODEMP = K.CODEMP AND ES.CODPROD = K.CODPROD LEFT JOIN cmp CP ON CP.CODEMP = K.CODEMP AND CP.CODPROD = K.CODPROD LEFT JOIN med3 MD ON MD.CODEMP = K.CODEMP AND MD.CODPROD = K.CODPROD LEFT JOIN oc_pos OP ON OP.CODEMP = K.CODEMP AND OP.CODPROD = K.CODPROD LEFT JOIN cot CT ON CT.CODEMP = K.CODEMP AND CT.CODPROD = K.CODPROD LEFT JOIN preco PZ ON PZ.CODPROD = K.CODPROD CROSS JOIN prm PR CROSS JOIN jan JA ), abc AS ( SELECT B.CODEMP, B.CODPROD, CASE WHEN B.PRECO_REF IS NOT NULL AND B.QTD_JANELA > 0 THEN B.QTD_JANELA * B.PRECO_REF ELSE 0 END AS VALOR_ABC FROM b1 B ), abc2 AS ( SELECT A.CODEMP, A.CODPROD, A.VALOR_ABC, SUM(A.VALOR_ABC) OVER (PARTITION BY A.CODEMP) AS TOT_ABC, NVL(SUM(A.VALOR_ABC) OVER (PARTITION BY A.CODEMP ORDER BY A.VALOR_ABC DESC, A.CODPROD ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 0) AS ACUM_ANT FROM abc A ), b2 AS ( SELECT B.*, CASE WHEN PR.ABC_CALCULADA = 1 AND B.PRECO_REF IS NOT NULL AND A2.TOT_ABC > 0 THEN CASE WHEN A2.ACUM_ANT / A2.TOT_ABC < PR.ABC_LIMITE_A THEN 'A' WHEN A2.ACUM_ANT / A2.TOT_ABC < PR.ABC_LIMITE_B THEN 'B' ELSE 'C' END END AS CURVA, CASE WHEN PR.ABC_CALCULADA = 1 THEN 'CALCULADA' ELSE 'SEM_FONTE' END AS CURVA_ORIGEM, A2.VALOR_ABC FROM b1 B LEFT JOIN abc2 A2 ON A2.CODEMP = B.CODEMP AND A2.CODPROD = B.CODPROD CROSS JOIN prm PR ), b3 AS ( SELECT B.*, CASE B.CURVA WHEN 'A' THEN PR.COBERTURA_ALVO_A WHEN 'B' THEN PR.COBERTURA_ALVO_B WHEN 'C' THEN PR.COBERTURA_ALVO_C ELSE PR.COBERTURA_SEM_CURVA END AS COB_ALVO, CASE PR.POLITICA_SEGURANCA WHEN 1 THEN B.DD * B.LT * PR.SEGURANCA_PCT_LT WHEN 2 THEN NVL(B.ESTMIN_CAD, 0) ELSE 0 END AS EST_SEG, B.EFP - B.CMP AS DISPONIVEL, B.EFP + B.QTD_OC_CONF AS POS_CONTRATADA FROM b2 B CROSS JOIN prm PR ), b4 AS ( SELECT B.*, B.LT + B.COB_ALVO AS HORIZONTE, (CASE WHEN PR.REGRA_PREVISAO_FIRME = 2 THEN B.CMP + B.DD * B.LT ELSE GREATEST(B.CMP, B.DD * B.LT) END) + B.EST_SEG AS PONTO_PEDIDO, (CASE WHEN PR.REGRA_PREVISAO_FIRME = 2 THEN B.CMP + B.DD * (B.LT + B.COB_ALVO) ELSE GREATEST(B.CMP, B.DD * (B.LT + B.COB_ALVO)) END) + B.EST_SEG AS REQUISITO, B.CMP + B.DD * (B.LT + B.COB_ALVO) + B.EST_SEG AS REQUISITO_SOMA, GREATEST(B.CMP, B.DD * (B.LT + B.COB_ALVO)) + B.EST_SEG AS REQUISITO_MAIOR, (CASE WHEN B.EFP < B.CMP THEN 0 WHEN B.DD <= 0 THEN NULL ELSE (B.EFP - CASE WHEN PR.REGRA_PREVISAO_FIRME = 2 THEN B.CMP ELSE 0 END) / B.DD END) AS COB_FISICA_DIAS, (CASE WHEN (B.EFP + B.QTD_OC_CONF) < B.CMP THEN 0 WHEN B.DD <= 0 THEN NULL ELSE ((B.EFP + B.QTD_OC_CONF) - CASE WHEN PR.REGRA_PREVISAO_FIRME = 2 THEN B.CMP ELSE 0 END) / B.DD END) AS COB_CONTRAT_DIAS FROM b3 B CROSS JOIN prm PR ), proj AS ( SELECT B.CODEMP, B.CODPROD, R.DT_PREV, R.DT_PREV - B.DT_BASE AS D_I, (CASE WHEN (B.EFP + R.ACUM_ANTES) < B.CMP THEN 0 WHEN B.DD <= 0 THEN NULL ELSE ((B.EFP + R.ACUM_ANTES) - CASE WHEN PR.REGRA_PREVISAO_FIRME = 2 THEN B.CMP ELSE 0 END) / B.DD END) AS T_ANTES, (CASE WHEN PR.REGRA_PREVISAO_FIRME = 2 THEN B.CMP + B.DD * (R.DT_PREV - B.DT_BASE) ELSE GREATEST(B.CMP, B.DD * (R.DT_PREV - B.DT_BASE)) END) - (B.EFP + R.ACUM_ANTES) AS FALTA_ANTES FROM b4 B JOIN rec2 R ON R.CODEMP = B.CODEMP AND R.CODPROD = B.CODPROD CROSS JOIN prm PR ), proj1 AS ( SELECT P.CODEMP, P.CODPROD, P.DT_PREV, P.T_ANTES, P.FALTA_ANTES, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY P.CODEMP, P.CODPROD ORDER BY P.DT_PREV) AS RN FROM proj P WHERE P.T_ANTES IS NOT NULL AND P.T_ANTES < P.D_I ), recsum AS ( SELECT R.CODEMP, R.CODPROD, SUM(R.QTD) AS QTD_DATADA, MIN(R.DT_PREV) AS DT_PROX_RECEB, SUM(CASE WHEN R.ORDEM_REC = 1 THEN R.QTD ELSE 0 END) AS QTD_PROX_RECEB FROM rec2 R GROUP BY R.CODEMP, R.CODPROD ), b5 AS ( SELECT B.*, RS.DT_PROX_RECEB, RS.QTD_PROX_RECEB, NVL(RS.QTD_DATADA, 0) AS QTD_OC_DATADA, CASE WHEN P1.CODPROD IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS FL_FALTA_ANTES_RECEB, P1.DT_PREV AS DT_RECEB_APOS_FALTA, P1.FALTA_ANTES AS QTD_FALTA_ANTES_RECEB, CASE WHEN P1.CODPROD IS NOT NULL THEN P1.T_ANTES ELSE (CASE WHEN (B.EFP + NVL(RS.QTD_DATADA, 0)) < B.CMP THEN 0 WHEN B.DD <= 0 THEN NULL ELSE ((B.EFP + NVL(RS.QTD_DATADA, 0)) - CASE WHEN PR.REGRA_PREVISAO_FIRME = 2 THEN B.CMP ELSE 0 END) / B.DD END) END AS T_FALTA_PROJ FROM b4 B LEFT JOIN proj1 P1 ON P1.CODEMP = B.CODEMP AND P1.CODPROD = B.CODPROD AND P1.RN = 1 LEFT JOIN recsum RS ON RS.CODEMP = B.CODEMP AND RS.CODPROD = B.CODPROD CROSS JOIN prm PR ), b6 AS ( SELECT B.*, CASE WHEN B.T_FALTA_PROJ IS NOT NULL AND B.T_FALTA_PROJ <= 3650 THEN B.DT_BASE + CAST(FLOOR(B.T_FALTA_PROJ) AS INTEGER) END AS DT_FALTA_EST, CASE WHEN B.FL_CONSIGNADO = 1 THEN 0 ELSE GREATEST(B.REQUISITO - B.POS_CONTRATADA, 0) END AS NEC_BRUTA, CASE WHEN B.FL_CONSIGNADO = 1 THEN 0 ELSE GREATEST(B.REQUISITO_SOMA - B.POS_CONTRATADA, 0) END AS NEC_SOMA, CASE WHEN B.FL_CONSIGNADO = 1 THEN 0 ELSE GREATEST(B.REQUISITO_MAIOR - B.POS_CONTRATADA, 0) END AS NEC_MAIOR FROM b5 B ), b7 AS ( SELECT B.*, LEAST(B.QTD_OC_NAO_CONF, B.NEC_BRUTA) AS NEC_EM_OC_NAO_CONF FROM b6 B ), b8 AS ( SELECT B.*, CASE WHEN 0 = 1 THEN LEAST(NVL(B.QTD_COTACAO, 0), B.NEC_BRUTA - B.NEC_EM_OC_NAO_CONF) END AS NEC_EM_COTACAO FROM b7 B ), b9 AS ( SELECT B.*, B.NEC_BRUTA - B.NEC_EM_OC_NAO_CONF - NVL(B.NEC_EM_COTACAO, 0) AS NEC_NAO_SOLIC, CASE WHEN NVL(B.LOTEMIN, 0) < 0 OR NVL(B.AGRUPMIN, 0) < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS FL_LOTE_INVALIDO FROM b8 B ), b10 AS ( SELECT B.*, CASE WHEN PR.LOTE_MULTIPLO = 1 AND B.NEC_NAO_SOLIC > 0 THEN CASE WHEN NVL(B.AGRUPMIN, 0) > 0 THEN CEIL(ROUND(GREATEST(B.NEC_NAO_SOLIC, CASE WHEN B.LOTEMIN > 0 THEN B.LOTEMIN ELSE 0 END) / B.AGRUPMIN, 6)) * B.AGRUPMIN ELSE GREATEST(B.NEC_NAO_SOLIC, CASE WHEN B.LOTEMIN > 0 THEN B.LOTEMIN ELSE 0 END) END END AS QTD_ARRED FROM b9 B CROSS JOIN prm PR ), plano AS ( SELECT B.*, CASE WHEN B.QTD_ARRED IS NOT NULL THEN B.QTD_ARRED - B.NEC_NAO_SOLIC END AS EXCESSO_ARRED, CASE WHEN B.PRECO_REF IS NOT NULL AND B.DISPONIVEL < 0 THEN -B.DISPONIVEL * B.PRECO_REF END AS VLR_FALTA_ATUAL, CASE WHEN B.PRECO_REF IS NOT NULL THEN B.NEC_NAO_SOLIC * B.PRECO_REF END AS VLR_NEC_NAO_SOLIC, B.N_CONS_NAO_CONC + B.N_PED_NAO_CONC + B.N_OC_NAO_CONC + B.N_COT_NAO_CONC AS N_NAO_CONC, CASE WHEN B.QTD_ESTOQUE < 0 OR B.COB_FISICA_DIAS = 0 THEN 'P1_CRITICO' WHEN B.T_FALTA_PROJ IS NOT NULL AND FLOOR(B.T_FALTA_PROJ) < B.LT THEN 'P2_RUPTURA_IMINENTE' WHEN B.POS_CONTRATADA < B.PONTO_PEDIDO + B.DD * PR.MARGEM_ATENCAO_DIAS THEN 'P3_ATENCAO' WHEN B.FL_SEM_GIRO = 1 AND B.QTD_ESTOQUE > 0 AND (B.QTD_PEDIDOS > 0 OR B.CMP > 0) THEN 'REVISAR_SEM_GIRO' WHEN B.DD > 0 AND B.COB_CONTRAT_DIAS > PR.COBERTURA_MAX_DIAS THEN 'P0_EXCESSO' WHEN B.FL_SEM_GIRO = 1 AND B.QTD_ESTOQUE > 0 THEN 'P0_SEM_GIRO' ELSE 'OK' END AS PRIORIDADE, CASE WHEN B.QTD_ESTOQUE < 0 THEN 'ESTOQUE_NEGATIVO;' ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN B.CMP > 0 AND B.DISPONIVEL < 0 THEN 'COMPROMISSO_MAIOR_QUE_ESTOQUE;' ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN B.COB_FISICA_DIAS = 0 AND B.QTD_ESTOQUE >= 0 AND B.DISPONIVEL >= 0 THEN 'SEM_COBERTURA_FISICA;' ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN B.FL_FALTA_ANTES_RECEB = 1 THEN 'FALTA_ANTES_RECEBIMENTO;' ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN B.T_FALTA_PROJ IS NOT NULL AND FLOOR(B.T_FALTA_PROJ) < B.LT THEN 'FALTA_DENTRO_LEAD_TIME;' ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN B.POS_CONTRATADA < B.PONTO_PEDIDO THEN 'ABAIXO_PONTO_PEDIDO;' WHEN B.POS_CONTRATADA < B.PONTO_PEDIDO + B.DD * PR.MARGEM_ATENCAO_DIAS THEN 'PROXIMO_PONTO_PEDIDO;' ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN B.FL_SEM_GIRO = 1 AND B.QTD_ESTOQUE > 0 AND (B.QTD_PEDIDOS > 0 OR B.CMP > 0) THEN 'SEM_GIRO_COM_COMPROMISSO;' WHEN B.FL_SEM_GIRO = 1 AND B.QTD_ESTOQUE > 0 THEN 'SEM_GIRO;' ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN B.DD > 0 AND B.COB_CONTRAT_DIAS > PR.COBERTURA_MAX_DIAS THEN 'COBERTURA_ACIMA_MAXIMO;' ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN B.FL_HIST_INSUF = 1 THEN 'HISTORICO_INSUFICIENTE;' ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN B.FL_CONSUMO_NEG = 1 THEN 'CONSUMO_LIQUIDO_NEGATIVO;' ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN B.N_CONS_NAO_CONC + B.N_PED_NAO_CONC + B.N_OC_NAO_CONC + B.N_COT_NAO_CONC > 0 THEN 'UNIDADE_NAO_CONCILIADA;' ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN B.QTD_OC_NAO_CONF > 0 THEN 'OC_NAO_CONFIRMADA;' ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN B.N_OC_ATRAS > 0 THEN 'OC_ATRASADA;' ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN B.N_OC_SEM_PREV > 0 THEN 'OC_SEM_PREVISAO;' ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN B.N_OC_ANTIGA > 0 THEN 'OC_ANTIGA_ABERTA;' ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN B.PRECO_REF IS NULL THEN 'SEM_PRECO_REFERENCIA;' ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN B.FL_LT_PADRAO = 1 THEN 'LEAD_TIME_PADRAO;' ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN B.FL_CONSIGNADO = 1 THEN 'CONSIGNADO_SEM_CALCULO;' ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN B.ESTMIN_CAD > 0 AND B.DISPONIVEL < B.ESTMIN_CAD THEN 'ABAIXO_ESTMIN_CADASTRO;' ELSE '' END || CASE WHEN B.FL_LOTE_INVALIDO = 1 THEN 'LOTE_MULTIPLO_INVALIDO;' ELSE '' END AS MOTIVOS FROM b10 B CROSS JOIN prm PR ), res AS ( SELECT PL.PRIORIDADE, COUNT(*) AS N_SKUS, SUM(CASE WHEN PL.DISPONIVEL < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS N_FALTA_ATUAL, SUM(NVL(PL.VLR_FALTA_ATUAL, 0)) AS VLR_FALTA_ATUAL, SUM(CASE WHEN PL.DISPONIVEL < 0 AND PL.PRECO_REF IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS N_FALTA_SEM_PRECO, SUM(CASE WHEN PL.NEC_NAO_SOLIC > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS N_NEC, SUM(NVL(PL.VLR_NEC_NAO_SOLIC, 0)) AS VLR_NEC_NAO_SOLIC, SUM(CASE WHEN PL.NEC_NAO_SOLIC > 0 AND PL.PRECO_REF IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS N_NEC_SEM_PRECO, SUM(CASE WHEN PL.NEC_EM_OC_NAO_CONF > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS N_NEC_OC_NAO_CONF, SUM(CASE WHEN PL.NEC_EM_COTACAO > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS N_NEC_COTACAO, SUM(PL.FL_FALTA_ANTES_RECEB) AS N_FALTA_ANTES_RECEB, SUM(PL.FL_HIST_INSUF) AS N_HIST_INSUF, SUM(CASE WHEN PL.N_NAO_CONC > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS N_UN_NAO_CONC, SUM(CASE WHEN PL.PRECO_REF IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS N_SEM_PRECO, SUM(PL.FL_LT_PADRAO) AS N_LT_PADRAO, SUM(CASE WHEN PL.N_OC_ATRAS > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS N_OC_ATRAS, SUM(CASE WHEN PL.N_OC_SEM_PREV > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS N_OC_SEM_PREV, SUM(CASE WHEN PL.QTD_OC_NAO_CONF > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS N_OC_NAO_CONF, SUM(CASE WHEN PL.N_OC_ANTIGA > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS N_OC_ANTIGA, SUM(CASE WHEN PL.N_OC_TOP_SEP > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS N_OC_TOP_SEP, SUM(PL.FL_CONSIGNADO) AS N_CONSIGNADO, SUM(PL.FL_LOTE_INVALIDO) AS N_LOTE_INVALIDO, SUM(PL.FL_CONSUMO_NEG) AS N_CONSUMO_NEG, SUM(CASE WHEN PL.CURVA IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS N_SEM_CURVA FROM plano PL GROUP BY PL.PRIORIDADE ) SELECT R.PRIORIDADE, R.N_SKUS, R.N_FALTA_ATUAL, ROUND(R.VLR_FALTA_ATUAL, 2) AS VLR_FALTA_ATUAL, R.N_FALTA_SEM_PRECO, R.N_NEC, ROUND(R.VLR_NEC_NAO_SOLIC, 2) AS VLR_NEC_NAO_SOLIC, R.N_NEC_SEM_PRECO, R.N_NEC_OC_NAO_CONF, R.N_NEC_COTACAO, R.N_FALTA_ANTES_RECEB, R.N_HIST_INSUF, R.N_UN_NAO_CONC, R.N_SEM_PRECO, R.N_LT_PADRAO, R.N_OC_ATRAS, R.N_OC_SEM_PREV, R.N_OC_NAO_CONF, R.N_OC_ANTIGA, R.N_OC_TOP_SEP, R.N_CONSIGNADO, R.N_LOTE_INVALIDO, R.N_CONSUMO_NEG, R.N_SEM_CURVA, 0 AS COTACAO_MAPEADA, TO_CHAR(JC.DT_BASE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS DT_BASE, JA.SNAPSHOT, TO_CHAR(JC.INI, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS JANELA_INI, TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(JC.M0, -1), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS JANELA_FIM, ROUND(JC.FRAC, 4) AS FRAC_PARCIAL, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TGFPRO PX WHERE PX.ATIVO = 'S' AND PX.CODPROD NOT IN (SELECT KX.CODPROD FROM chaves KX)) AS N_ATIVOS_FORA FROM res R CROSS JOIN janc JC CROSS JOIN jan JA ORDER BY (CASE R.PRIORIDADE WHEN 'P1_CRITICO' THEN 1 WHEN 'P2_RUPTURA_IMINENTE' THEN 2 WHEN 'P3_ATENCAO' THEN 3 WHEN 'REVISAR_SEM_GIRO' THEN 4 WHEN 'P0_EXCESSO' THEN 5 WHEN 'P0_SEM_GIRO' THEN 6 ELSE 7 END)

Q_SNAP_PROBE.sql: WITH prm AS ( SELECT CAST(TO_NUMBER(?) AS INTEGER) AS CODEMP, TO_DATE(?, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS DT_INI, TO_DATE(?, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS DT_FIM FROM DUAL ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS N, TO_CHAR(MIN(S.DATA_SNAPSHOT), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS PRIMEIRO, TO_CHAR(MAX(S.DATA_SNAPSHOT), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ULTIMO FROM BI_F_SUGESTAO_COMPRA S CROSS JOIN prm PR WHERE S.DATA_SNAPSHOT >= PR.DT_INI AND S.DATA_SNAPSHOT < PR.DT_FIM + 1 AND S.CODEMP = PR.CODEMP
